newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN TELINFO SAYS STILL EYEING ASIA.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN TELINFO SAYS STILL EYEING ASIA.

text.p: Belgian data communications company Telinfo NV said on Friday that it would continue to invest in Asia but it would take time to reap benefits.

Telinfo chairman John Cordier told a news conference the non-European share in turnover had stayed at two percent in 1996. "That doesn't mean we're not investing further (outside Europe). But you cannot set up a circuit in 24 hours."
"We give great importance to countries such as China where we have a number of contracts, India and Indonesia where we are also involved in the Internet," he said.
Cordier said that the group's turnover rose primarily in Germany, Italy and Britain in 1996, but the share of the Benelux countries in turnover fell to 79 percent from 84 percent a year earlier.
